en: Jesus, You are my treasure,
Worth more than silver and gold.
Your presence is better than anything,
Thank You for staying with me all my life.
Jesus, You are my treasure;
In You there is peace.
Thank You for hearing my prayers—
Your grace surrounds me.

zh: 祢用祢的愛 吸引我
領我走天涯 到海角
en: With Your love, You draw me
To run and follow in Your steps;
Lead me to the ends of the earth,
To walk upon the path of grace.

zh: 主阿我愛祢 祢真好
謝謝祢愛我 像個寶
en: Lord, I love You; You are so good,
Be my strength through all my life;
Thank You for loving me like a treasure,
I will obey You all my life.
